description.value: Happy Hong Kong Cafe is a nostalgic Hong Kong-style Cha Chaan Teng located inside the Abercorn Inn in Richmond, BC, evoking the bustling retro cafe culture of 1990s Hong Kong with vintage-inspired decor. The menu spans classic Cantonese comfort dishes — from Baked Pork Chop with Tomato Sauce on Rice and Hainanese Chicken Laksa to congee and Hong Kong French Toast — blending East-meets-West techniques across a broad, eclectic offering. Touring cyclists stopping near Richmond's Bridgeport corridor will find a full sit-down meal with both dine-in and pickup options in a hotel-hosted setting.

Takeout is confirmed by explicit pickup and delivery options on the ordering page. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities appears in either the OSM tags or website content; OSM diet tags (vegetarian=no, gluten_free=no) are not corroborated by the website so those are left null.
